Geographies Served Programs One Rupee Thali (Fight Against Hunger and Malnutrition) State West Bengal States West Bengal One Rupee Thali (Fight Against Hunger and Malnutrition) program is a flagship program of Dreamer Trust under which we provide cooked nutritious meals to 250+ underprivileged communities every day in an effort to eradicate hunger and malnutrition as well as restore financial solvency. The programme at offering nutritious and wholesome meals to children, that provide the necessary nutrients needed to develop their cognitive abilities to focus on learning by working to eliminate classroom hunger and attract more children to schools, thus increasing school enrollment, attendance, and performance. Emergency & Relief State West Bengal States West Bengal Dreamer Trust responds to rapid onset disaster to meet immediate needs to affected populations and support the transition towards recovery and rehabilitation. In building the resilience of vulnerable people, we work with hand. Mukta Shiksha Pathshala State West Bengal States West Bengal To provide fully free quality and value-based education to underprivileged children of remote rural and slum areas, scheduled castes, scheduled tribes and orphans. Impact Metrics Meal Distributed Program Name One Rupee Thali (Fight Against Hunger and Malnutrition) Year-wise Metrics 2021-22 36000 2022-23 126500 Education Program Program Name Mukta Shiksha Pathshala Year-wise Metrics 2021-22 20 2022-23 50 Milestones & Track Record Dreamer Trust has expanded from initially distributing food baskets to now running the 'One Rupee Thali' program serving hundreds of meals daily, as well as launching education programs for underprivileged children. --> --> Leadership Team Mithu Chowdhury Founder & Chairman Rajib Purohit Secretary Priyanka Dey Treasurer Sumi Sen Administrative Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AADTD8093K Registration Number IV-190300378/2021 CSR Form 1 CSR00036342 VO ID / Darpan ID WB/2021/0290388 --> 80G AADTD8093KF20221 12A AADTD8093KE20221 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Kolkata, West Bengal Since 2020 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Men --> Impact Dreamer Trust has so far served 1,62,500+ meals to the needy and marginalized. Vision and Mission Dreamer Trust's vision is to eradicate hunger and malnutrition in India, provide quality education to underprivileged children, and support the rural poor with health services, while its mission is to feed 50,000 needy people daily by 2025 and ensure no children in India are deprived of education.
